answer: Rare-dialect fluency proofs stop Sybils. First, each agent registers one rare regional dialect and passes a live ten minute talk with two natives. Second, tests repeat quarterly, so rented fluency expires fast. Third, a failed test freezes work ninety days and forfeits a $30 bond. Fourth, each dialect caps at fifty agents, so one operator cannot clone a thousand copies. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 speakers, $30,000 in bonds and $24,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust climbs like a summit trail: a willow bends in one valley, cedar in another, like traders speaking local tongues.
